keys: Was that the twenty-third? Never mind. I made another you.
en: Was that the twenty-third? Never mind. I made another you.

keys: Again? Hold still. You always twitch before the eyes are finished.
en: Again? Hold still. You always twitch before the eyes are finished.
hu: Már megint? Maradj nyugton. Mindig rángatózol, mielőtt elkészülnek a szemeid.

keys: The fabricator remembered your scars. I told it not to.
en: The fabricator remembered your scars. I told it not to.

keys: You are getting easier to print. I am not sure that is good.
en: You are getting easier to print. I am not sure that is good.
hu: Egyre könnyebb kinyomtatni téged. Nem vagyok biztos benne, hogy ez jó.

keys: The body is new. The memory is not. Your Blood Memory fragments are safe.
en: The body is new. The memory is not. Your Blood Memory fragments are safe.
hu: A test új. Az emlék nem. A Vérmemória-töredékeid biztonságban vannak.

en: No one escapes my test arena, foolish dog! Lets scrap this experiment!

en: I need backup! The experiment is out of control!
hu: Erősítés kell! A kísérlet kicsúszott az irányítás alól!
